query:
WITH requested(id) AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM json_each(?)
               ), owners AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT s.document_id,s.paragraph_id
                   FROM requested r JOIN sentences s ON s.id=r.id
               ), document_owners(document_id) AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT document_id FROM owners
               ), paragraph_owners(paragraph_id) AS (
                   SELECT DISTINCT paragraph_id FROM owners
               )
               SELECT 'document' AS "owner_kind!: String",
                      m.document_id AS "owner_id!: i64",
                      k.authored_key AS "key!: String",
                      v.type_tag AS "type_tag!: i64",
                      v.display_value AS "display_value!: String",
                      v.numeric_projection,
                      m.element_ordinal AS "element_ordinal!: i64"
               FROM document_owners o
               JOIN document_metadata m ON m.document_id=o.document_id
               JOIN metadata_keys k ON k.id=m.key_id
               JOIN metadata_values v ON v.id=m.value_id
               UNION ALL
               SELECT 'paragraph' AS "owner_kind!: String",
                      m.paragraph_id AS "owner_id!: i64",
                      k.authored_key AS "key!: String",
                      v.type_tag AS "type_tag!: i64",
                      v.display_value AS "display_value!: String",
                      v.numeric_projection,
                      m.element_ordinal AS "element_ordinal!: i64"
               FROM paragraph_owners o
               JOIN paragraph_metadata m ON m.paragraph_id=o.paragraph_id
               JOIN metadata_keys k ON k.id=m.key_id
               JOIN metadata_values v ON v.id=m.value_id
               ORDER BY 1,2,3,7
